generation: Generation 2 — Capability Architecture & Symbiotic Platform Engineering

research.cycle_semantics: minimum_full_cycles is a mandatory floor; target_full_cycles is a maturity checkpoint for global saturation reassessment, not an upper bound. There is no maximum cycle count. RESEARCH_ELICITATION continues for 15, 20 or more cycles whenever material architectural information gain remains.
research.continuation_rule: Cycle count never authorizes CAPABILITY_SYNTHESIS by itself. Continue research while material new findings, unresolved enterprise/security/reliability/interoperability/governance gaps, ownerless negative space, consequential evidence divergences, or unresolved cross-cutting primitives remain. Transition only when capability saturation and completeness gates are actually satisfied.
research.late_cycle_selection_rule: As saturation increases, prefer research-by-exception rather than mechanically revisiting every capability. Do not routinely reopen SATURATED capabilities; reopen only for material new evidence, newly promoted cross-cutting primitives, negative-space discovery, contradiction, or repository validation that creates a substantive unanswered question. Concentrate effort on non-saturated capabilities and unresolved material gaps.
research.saturation_rule: A capability is SATURATED only after principal representatives are covered and two consecutive eligible revisits produce no material new architectural finding, or remaining questions require repository validation rather than external research. Reaching target_full_cycles never implies saturation; any material new finding resets the relevant no-material-finding streak.
research_evidence_classes: consolidated systems and official product documentation
research.research_evidence_rule: Triangulate evidence by fitness for the claim. Papers may independently create findings/candidates but do not by themselves mandate SB architecture; promotion normally requires multi-source corroboration or structurally unavoidable need. Literature is selective evidence inside eligible revisits and an explicit evidence channel for negative-space discovery. Evidence depth may justify research beyond the target cycle checkpoint; breadth is not pursued merely to inflate cycle count.
research.candidate_inventory_authority: project_docs/generation-2/research/CAPABILITY_DISCOVERY_REGISTER.md plus prior state history and capability dossiers; compact representations do not revoke prior candidates
research.historical_coverage_authority: project_docs/generation-2/research/REPRESENTATIVE_COVERAGE.md and capability dossiers; all prior coverage remains authoritative and unsuperseded
research.finding_inventory_authority: project_docs/generation-2/research/FINDING_INDEX.md plus capability dossiers and prior state history; compact state does not revoke prior findings

Adaptive Governed Work Surfaces.required_boundary: Enterprise → Station → Role → Person; higher invariants non-weakenable; Station is first-class capability-exposure/delegated-administration/hierarchical-SB boundary.
Adaptive Governed Work Surfaces.required_authoring_rule: Users express intent and compose constrained semantic components; AI is sole materializer over valid entities/domains/capabilities/permissions/contracts and must escalate canonical domain/process changes.
required_proofs: AI request requiring domain change escalated

enterprise_completeness_negative_space_g.rule: CAPABILITY_SYNTHESIS remains blocked after cycle 7 until enterprise archetypes and negative-space concerns are classified, material semantic-owner gaps are researched or explicitly deferred with rationale, and no material category remains ownerless. Commercial metering/entitlements/rating/billing/payment and relative operational complexity pricing must be explicitly challenged as part of cost/quotas/metering/FinOps negative space if not promoted/researched earlier. Scientific literature is an explicit evidence channel: challenge the taxonomy against surveys, formal models, empirical studies and research gaps that may expose fundamental problems mainstream products solve incompletely or not at all. Passing cycle 7 or cycle 10 does not close this gate if material gaps remain.

gates.RESEARCH_ELICITATION: OPEN — all active macro-capabilities require sufficient evidential coverage/saturation, minimum cycles and the post-cycle-7 negative-space gate. No maximum research cycle exists; target_full_cycles=10 is only a maturity checkpoint.
gates.ENTERPRISE_COMPLETENESS_NEGATIVE_SPACE_R: NOT_YET_ELIGIBLE — mandatory after completed_full_cycles >= 7 and before CAPABILITY_SYNTHESIS; remains open while material ownerless or under-researched concerns exist.

Research-cycle policy is now explicitly saturation-driven: 7 is a floor, 10 is a maturity checkpoint, there is no maximum, and later cycles become research-by-exception as capabilities saturate.
